text: {"rules":[],"notes":"M.G.L. c. 186, § 11 sets a 14-day written notice to quit for nonpayment of rent under a written lease. It also gives a right to cure by paying rent, interest and costs, and requires a hearing continuance when a government payment was delayed. This is a general nonpayment termination procedure. It does not limit evictions to listed causes, is not a notice tied to such a limit, and does not provide relocation assistance. None of the six categories (rent increase limits, just cause eviction, security deposits, application or screening fees, screening restrictions, algorithmic rent setting) applies, so no rule is recorded."}
